baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ joins personal guidance, motion toward a destination, and a result marked by فَـ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance supplies gentle indication toward a road or truth, ربك names the sovereign destination of that orientation, and خشية is the reverent fear that follows recognition rather than the force used to compel it.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a road or truth supplies the mode and direction of the offered guidance.
Lordship, ownership, and obeyed sovereignty identify the one toward whom the addressee is oriented.
Fear joined with awe supplies the responsive state produced after the directional encounter.

changed_reading.before: I will tell you about God so that you become afraid.
changed_reading.after: I will gently orient you toward recognition of your sovereign Lord, so that reverent awe can arise from that recognition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive رَبِّكَ makes the destination a relation to your Lord, while أَهْدِيَكَ and فَتَخْشَىٰ describe entry into and response within that relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The رب complex includes repairing, completing, tending, feeding, and growth. Guidance toward ربك can therefore recover a formative relation in which the addressee is corrected stage by stage, with awe as the fitting discipline of one being tended rather than merely threatened.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction supplies entry into a relation instead of a bare declaration about it.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship a continuing formative activity.
Feeding and organic growth reinforce the gradual, life-forming side of the mapped رب complex.
Awe supplies the disciplined response to being restored under formative lordship.

changed_reading.before: Your Lord is chiefly the superior whose power should frighten you.
changed_reading.after: Your Lord is also the one who tends, repairs, and brings you toward completion; guidance restores that formative bond, and awe is its disciplined fruit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from أَهْدِيَكَ to فَتَخْشَىٰ permits the final verb to name an informed state reached through disclosure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The guidance branch includes clarification and making a way known, while خشية has a figurative knowledge branch. Their sequence permits awe to be read as knowledge-bearing recognition: the guide makes the Lord knowable, and what becomes known reorders affect.

activation_trace.role: Clarification and definition of the true road supply the disclosure that precedes the final state.
The branch of knowledge related to the Lord supplies an epistemic field for the destination.
The figurative sense of knowing lets خشية register recognition without erasing its affective force.

changed_reading.before: Guidance transmits information and fear follows as a separate emotion.
changed_reading.after: Guidance produces a knowledge of the Lord whose very form is awe: cognition and reverence become one changed orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Against the surah's opening register of extraction, release, return, and a single rebuking cry, أَهْدِيَكَ becomes an offered mode of relocation. The focus presents gentle, voluntary orientation before the compelled displacement and return described elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication supplies the non-coercive mode set against the surrounding motion images.
Tearing something from its settled place supplies a forceful form of relocation.
The loop that can be tied or released supplies a transition from binding into motion.
Return to a thing or place supplies the compulsory destination questioned by the speakers.
A rebuking cry supplies the abrupt command by which the later return occurs.

structural_cues: 79:10 asks whether they will be returned and 79:13 answers with one rebuke, whereas 79:19 uses a first-person offer plus directional إِلَىٰ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forceful removal, release, return, rebuke, and gentle direction; I infer a contrast between voluntary and compelled relocation. The opening motions may instead describe a separate scene with no intended contrast to Moses's offer.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is simply one movement toward the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is a mercy-window for willing reorientation before an unavoidable, forceful return makes movement non-negotiable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby pairing of agitated hearts with lowered eyes gives bodily articulation to فَتَخْشَىٰ. Awe is not only an interior opinion; it can reorganize pulse, attention, gaze, and posture.

activation_trace.role: Fear with awe supplies the focus state that the bodily context expands.
The heart branch locates one dimension of the response in the inner bodily center.
Agitation and heart-pounding supply the kinetic affect of overwhelming encounter.
Physical sight supplies the outward organ whose conduct displays the inward state.
Lowering and submission supply the visible posture taken by the gaze.

structural_cues: 79:8-9 moves directly from hearts to eyes, coupling inward agitation with outward lowering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart agitation and lowered vision; I treat them as an embodied analogue of خشية. They may instead depict involuntary resurrection terror, distinct from the cultivated awe invited in 79:19.

changed_reading.before: Awe is a private feeling or belief.
changed_reading.after: Awe is a whole-person posture in which inward agitation, attention, and the outward gaze are brought low before the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The three successive directional clauses form a corrective route: Moses is sent toward the one who has exceeded bounds, that person is invited toward purification and growth, and Moses offers to guide him toward his Lord. خشية becomes the inward boundary that answers طغيان.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction supplies the corrective route rather than mere condemnation.
Repair and formation supply the destination's capacity to restore what exceeded its measure.
Awe supplies the self-limiting response at the end of the corrective route.
Going and proceeding initiate the chain of directed movement.
Exceeding the limit names the disordered trajectory that guidance must reverse.
Purity and rectification supply the first named transformation on the route.

structural_cues: 79:17-19 repeats إِلَىٰ across the mission to Pharaoh, the invitation to purification, and guidance to the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies going, exceeded bounds, purification, guidance, and awe; I infer a staged reversal in which awe checks excess. Purification may instead be a coordinate invitation rather than an intermediate stage caused by guidance.

changed_reading.before: Moses offers Pharaoh a general religious lesson.
changed_reading.after: Moses offers a route that reverses boundary-breaking motion: purification begins the turn, guidance supplies direction, and awe becomes an inner limit before the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus stands between two calls. The Lord calls Moses and sends him; Pharaoh later gathers a public and calls out his own highest lordship. أَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ is therefore a redirection between rival chains of voice and authority, not an abstract mention of deity.

activation_trace.role: Guidance supplies the act of redirecting allegiance and attention.
Sovereignty and obeyed mastery make the destination a contested authority.
The raised call supplies the commissioning voice from which Moses's offer proceeds.
Driving and gathering a group supplies the manufactured public for Pharaoh's counter-call.
The second raised call mirrors the commissioning call while serving the opposite claim.
Greatness joined to domination supplies the self-exalting content of the rival lordship.

structural_cues: 79:16 says his Lord called him; 79:23-24 says Pharaoh gathered, called, and declared himself the highest lord. The offer in 79:19 lies between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two calls, a gathered audience, and a self-exalting lordship claim; I infer mirrored communication chains and contested allegiance. The repetition of calling may be narrative only, without making the two scenes formal counterparts.

changed_reading.before: To your Lord identifies the topic Moses will teach.
changed_reading.after: To your Lord redirects Pharaoh out of his mass-amplified claim to mastery and toward the authority that first commissioned the guide.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moses does not merely speak: he shows a manifest sign. Pharaoh's denial, disobedience, turning away, and purposeful striving then form an active counter-route. The result فَتَخْشَىٰ is an offered possibility requiring uptake, not an effect imposed mechanically by adequate evidence.

activation_trace.role: Gentle clarification supplies an invitation that can be accepted or refused.
Awe supplies the unrealized response toward which the invitation points.
Showing and making visible supply the guide's evidential action.
A manifest sign supplies the object made available for recognition.
Contradiction of truth supplies the first act of refusal despite disclosure.
Departure from obedience turns cognitive rejection into enacted refusal.
Turning one's back supplies the bodily reversal of the offered direction.
Purposeful movement toward an aim supplies a rival trajectory energized by Pharaoh himself.

structural_cues: The فَـ sequence of showing, denial, and disobedience is followed by ثُمَّ and a bodily turn away, narrating an alternative to the focus's hoped-for فَتَخْشَىٰ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure followed by denial and a purposeful counter-movement; I infer that guidance preserves agency and that awe depends on uptake. Grammatically, فَتَخْشَىٰ can remain the intended result without encoding a formal condition.

changed_reading.before: Sufficient guidance and evidence should automatically produce awe.
changed_reading.after: Guidance makes a truthful route visible while leaving room for a deliberate counter-route; awe is the possible fruit of reception, not coerced cognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the focus, guidance aims to produce خشية; later, a case becomes a lesson for one who already has خشية, remembrance is available, and warning addresses one who has خشية. Awe thus behaves as both result and receptive capacity in a feedback process: an initial openness receives guidance, and received guidance deepens awe.

activation_trace.role: Guidance supplies the input intended to generate and deepen the receptive state.
Awe supplies both the focus's intended result and, by repetition, the capacity for later reception.
Making one condition a lesson for another supplies transfer from Pharaoh's case to a receptive observer.
A reminder supplies material that becomes active only when it is taken up.
Warning that awakens caution supplies a later guidance mode directed toward the awe-capable hearer.

structural_cues: The focus says فَتَخْشَىٰ, while 79:26 says لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ and 79:45 says مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا, moving خشية from result to audience criterion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies awe as result and repeats it as the qualification of lesson- and warning-recipients; I infer a feedback relation rather than a one-way sequence. The repetitions may simply identify similar audiences without implying prior degrees of awe.

changed_reading.before: Guidance first occurs and awe begins only afterward.
changed_reading.after: Guidance and awe can reinforce one another: a seed of receptivity lets warning become guidance, and guidance matures that receptivity into deeper awe.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence gives concrete scale to the formative رب baseline: measured creation, joined construction, proportion, emergence from concealment, pasture, anchoring, and benefit form an ordered habitat. Guidance to ربك becomes instruction in reading a world already bearing the work of sustaining lordship.

activation_trace.role: Clarifying a road or truth supplies the act of making the world's ordered signs legible.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the governing pattern instantiated by the creation sequence.
Awe supplies the response to recognizing sustaining order at cosmic scale.
Measuring and proportioning supply prior intelligence in the created order.
Building by joining parts supplies the architectural coherence of the sky.
Integrity and completion in the thing itself supply finished proportion.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the release of sustaining resources.
Pasture supplies concrete nourishment within the ordered habitat.
Fixity and rooted stability supply the habitat's anchoring function.
Useful enjoyment and benefit identify the creature-facing purpose of the ordered environment.

structural_cues: 79:27-33 moves from the sky's construction through light, earth, water, pasture, and anchored mountains to the explicit beneficiary phrase لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measurement, construction, proportion, emergence, nourishment, stability, and benefit; I infer that these enact the nurturing branch of رب. They can alternatively evidence sheer creative power without foregrounding nurture.

changed_reading.before: To your Lord points toward an unseen title of authority.
changed_reading.after: To your Lord points through the measurable architecture and provisions of the inhabited world toward the one whose lordship continually forms and sustains it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final contrast operationalizes خشية. One route prefers the nearer life; the other anticipates standing before the Lord and restrains the self from its inclining desire. Awe is therefore a governance capacity that interrupts preference and redirects action, not merely a terminal feeling.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign lordship supplies the authority before whom choices become answerable.
Awe supplies the focus state whose behavioral operation the later contrast displays.
Choosing one thing over another supplies the preference that moral orientation must govern.
The nearer or lower world supplies the short-range object preferred by the opposing route.
Fear in expectation of harm supplies the anticipatory force paired with standing before the Lord.
A station or standing in place supplies the scene of accountability that makes anticipation concrete.
Checking and restraining an act supply awe's practical inhibitory function.
The living self supplies the governed subject rather than an external enemy.
The self's inclination supplies the directional pressure that restraint must counter.

structural_cues: 79:37-41 balances طَغَىٰ وَءَاثَرَ against خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى, then assigns each route a different مَأْوَىٰ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference, nearness, anticipated standing, restraint, self, and inclination; I infer that خشية in the focus matures into this self-governing sequence. خشية and خوف remain distinct terms, and the latter may stress threat more narrowly.

changed_reading.before: Awe is the endpoint after one is guided.
changed_reading.after: Awe becomes an active faculty: awareness of standing before the Lord interrupts near-term preference and governs the self's contrary inclinations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing questions seek the Hour's anchorage, but its endpoint is to the Lord and the messenger is only a warner. The repeated إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ retroactively bounds أَهْدِيَكَ: a human guide can orient and warn, while final knowledge, settlement, and control terminate with the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Direction toward truth supplies the legitimate but limited work of the human guide.
Sovereignty supplies the final locus beyond the guide's delegated role.
Questioning and requesting supply the demand for knowledge that tests the messenger's boundary.
A vessel's settling at anchorage supplies the image of the Hour's fixed arrival.
The limit at which something ends supplies the terminus reserved for the Lord.
Warning that awakens caution defines the messenger's bounded mode of guidance.

structural_cues: 79:19 says إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ and 79:44 repeats إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ for the Hour's terminus; 79:45 then narrows the addressee's role with إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questions, anchorage, an endpoint with the Lord, and a bounded warning role; I infer that the closing phrase rereads Moses's guidance as delegated mediation. The closing addressee may be distinct from Moses, so the role-boundary is analogical across the surah rather than direct narration.

changed_reading.before: I will guide you may sound like the guide possesses the destination and all relevant knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The guide can point, show, and warn, but he stops at the Lord's limit; arrival, final settlement, and ultimate knowledge are not his to control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the هدي branch for the one or part that goes in front, rather than the ordinary verbal gloss. It remains anchored in أَهْدِيَكَ, the directional إِلَىٰ, and the surah's precedence/following sequence. Render it only as a spatial image of personal escort, not as proof that Pharaoh is grammatically commanded to follow Moses.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The direct object in أَهْدِيَكَ and destination in إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ allow guidance to be imagined as the guide taking a front position and conducting the addressee.

activation_trace.role: The guide or first part that advances supplies a front-positioned, embodied mode of guidance.
Advancing and preceding supply the motion of taking the lead.
Following behind supplies the complementary position of one conducted by a leader.
Coming after another reinforces an ordered procession rather than verbal instruction alone.

changed_reading.before: Moses offers Pharaoh directions from a distance.
changed_reading.after: Moses offers to go ahead and personally conduct Pharaoh along a route whose destination is Pharaoh's Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading activates the nominal هدي offered to a sanctuary, so it is distant from the ordinary verb and must not be stated as a literal sacrifice. It remains anchored through أَهْدِيَكَ, the holy-place and purification cues, and movement toward the Lord. Render it as a ritual analogy in which guidance helps dedicate the purified self, never as a claim that Pharaoh is an offering-object.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ can carry a faint consecratory image when the direct object is conducted toward the Lord after the invitation to purification.

activation_trace.role: The consecrated offering conveyed to the sanctuary supplies the ritual analogy of directed dedication.
Lordship supplies the recipient and terminus of the analogical dedication.
The purified place supplies a sacred spatial field for the mission.
Purity and rectification supply the preparation of the self before analogical dedication.

changed_reading.before: Guidance adds correct information to Pharaoh.
changed_reading.after: At a contained ritual level, guidance conducts a purified self out of self-possession and toward dedication to its Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant activation because it uses the packet's non-dominant ه د د mapping for the focus occurrence. It remains inspectably anchored by that supplied split mapping, the focus's خشية, and the surah's rebuke, deterrent punishment, and warning. Downstream prose must label it a split-root threat-shadow, not redefine هداية as تهديد or make coercion the primary reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps the focus root ه د ي not only to its dominant guidance inventory but also to ه د د, whose threat branch can cast a secondary edge over فَتَخْشَىٰ.

activation_trace.role: Threat and intimidation supply the non-dominant warning edge activated beneath the guidance surface.
Fear with awe supplies the focus outcome to which the threat-shadow attaches.
The forceful rebuking cry supplies an audible warning analogue.
Punishment that deters observers supplies the consequence-bearing edge of warning.
Warning that awakens caution connects fear to a legitimate communicative function without collapsing it into coercion.

changed_reading.before: The offer is purely gentle and contains no warning edge.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, the gentle offer carries a secondary warning: refusal leaves the addressee exposed to the deterrent consequences that guidance would help him face in awe.

strongest_changes: The repeated directional sequence makes guidance a reversal from transgressive excess through purification toward awe.
The two calls and Pharaoh's highest-lord claim make ربك a contested transfer of allegiance.
The creation sequence turns formative lordship into visible architecture, stability, nourishment, and benefit.
The contrast between preference and restraint turns awe into practical self-governance.
The later lesson and warning make awe both an outcome of guidance and a capacity for receiving it.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah order made the focus a hinge between commissioned invitation and refused counter-movement, while later creation, judgment, and warning sections successively expanded what guidance, lordship, and awe do. The packet's split roots also preserved contained readings that a consensus paraphrase would normally suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact semantic distance between خشية in the focus and خوف at the standing before the Lord remains live.
The opening motion agents are unspecified here, so the voluntary-versus-compelled contrast is structural and analogical rather than referentially secure.
The feedback reading of awe may reflect rhetorical recurrence rather than a strict causal loop.
The closing messenger-role limit may apply analogically across different addressees rather than directly continuing Moses's scene.
The escort, consecration, and ه د د threat-shadow readings should remain exploratory activations, not lexical replacements.
